description: This file defines a utility class 'ArgParser' for parsing command line arguments in Java. It provides methods to retrieve flags, check for data, and track parsing position.

classes.name: ArgParser
classes.description: A helper class for parsing command line arguments, allowing iteration over flags and data segments.

methods.name: ArgParser
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the parser with an array of command line arguments.

methods.name: nextFlag
methods.description: Returns the next argument if it is a flag starting with '--', advancing the position.

methods.name: hasData
methods.description: Checks whether there are 'count' tokens ahead that are not flags, without advancing the position.

methods.name: nextData
methods.description: Returns the next argument data, advancing the position.

methods.name: remaining
methods.description: Returns the number of remaining arguments.

methods.name: pos
methods.description: Returns the current parser position index.
